annotations.title: Unix timestamp converter: convert a Unix timestamp to a date and time, or a date to a timestamp

description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds, detected automatically) to ISO date and time, or an ISO date to a Unix timestamp. Without input, returns the current time in both forms. Use to read timestamps in logs and APIs. Example: value=1792281600. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

value.description: Unix seconds/milliseconds or an ISO date (default now)
